categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt properly configured with sitemap reference
@astrojs/sitemap integration for automatic sitemap generation
Canonical URLs correctly generated for all pages
trailingSlash: 'never' ensures clean URLs
_redirects file handles sitemap alias (301)
Astro SSG ensures fast static HTML output

findings.title: Site Not Deployed
findings.description: foodintolerancecheck.com currently returns a parked page (114 bytes) that redirects to /lander via JavaScript. No actual site content is served.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the Astro build to a hosting provider (Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, Vercel, etc.) and verify DNS configuration.

findings.title: Missing Security Headers
findings.description: No Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, or Strict-Transport-Security headers configured. While this is a static site, security headers improve trust signals.
findings.recommendation: Add security headers via hosting provider configuration or _headers file: X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin.

findings.title: OG Type Hardcoded as 'website'
findings.description: BaseLayout sets og:type to 'website' for all pages. Blog posts and guides should use 'article' for better social sharing and SEO signals.
findings.recommendation: Add an optional `ogType` prop to BaseLayout. Default to 'website', but set 'article' for blog posts and guide pages.

findings.title: Font Loading Not Optimized
findings.description: Loading 5 Outfit font weights (300-700) via separate CSS imports in global.css. Only 400, 500, 600, 700 appear to be used in the design.
findings.recommendation: Remove unused weight 300 import. Consider using a single @fontsource variable font import if available.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Strong E-E-A-T signals: named author (Dr. Emily Carter, Registered Dietitian)
References to authoritative sources (NHS, BDA, NICE, AAAAI, Monash, EAACI)
Clear medical disclaimers on every page
Detailed About page with editorial standards and methodology
Evidence-based content with blockquote citations
Good content hierarchy with question-based H2 headings

findings.title: Thin Content: Low FODMAP Guide
findings.description: guides/low-fodmap is only 33 lines with minimal content - just 3 phase descriptions and references. Competing pages have extensive food lists, meal plans, and detailed guidance.
findings.recommendation: Expand with: high FODMAP food list table, low FODMAP alternatives, serving size guidance, common mistakes, meal plan examples, and cross-link to blog/low-fodmap-foods.

findings.title: Thin Content: Elimination Diet Planner
findings.description: tools/elimination-diet-planner is only 34 lines. As a 'planner' tool, it should offer interactive or downloadable content, not just 3 bullet-point protocols.
findings.recommendation: Add interactive meal plan template, printable PDF option, sample weekly plan, and more detailed reintroduction schedule.

findings.title: Thin Content: IBS & Food Intolerance Guide
findings.description: guides/ibs-food-intolerance is 47 lines. Given IBS affects 10-15% of the population and is a high-volume search topic, this page needs more depth.
findings.recommendation: Add: IBS subtypes (IBS-C, IBS-D, IBS-M), specific FODMAP triggers by IBS subtype, stress-gut connection, when to see a gastroenterologist, and red flag symptoms.

findings.title: No Contact Email
findings.description: Neither the About page, Footer, nor Privacy page include a contact email. This weakens E-E-A-T trust signals and makes it harder for users/crawlers to verify legitimacy.
findings.recommendation: Add a contact email (e.g., hello@foodintolerancecheck.com) to the About page and Footer.

findings.title: Image Reuse Across Unrelated Pages
findings.description: vegetables-fodmap.jpg is used on both /guides/low-fodmap and /guides/ibs-food-intolerance. lab-testing.jpg is used on /guides/test-guide and /blog/are-food-intolerance-tests-accurate.
findings.recommendation: Use unique, context-specific images for each page to improve visual diversity and image SEO.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: All 23 pages have unique, keyword-rich title tags
All pages have compelling meta descriptions under 160 characters
Single H1 per page with clear hierarchy (H1 > H2 > H3)
Question-based H2 headings that match search intent
Strong internal linking between related pages
Breadcrumb navigation on all inner pages
Descriptive anchor text for internal links

findings.title: Title Tag Brand Inconsistency
findings.description: Some pages include 'FoodCheck' brand in title (e.g., blog posts) while others don't (tool pages). Consistent brand presence in titles improves brand recognition in SERPs.
findings.recommendation: Standardize title format: '[Page Topic] - FoodCheck' or 'FoodCheck | [Page Topic]' across all pages.

findings.title: Missing FAQPage Schema on Homepage FAQ
findings.description: Homepage renders 5 FAQ items via JavaScript (checker.js) but has no FAQPage schema. The FAQ page at /faq has proper schema, but the homepage FAQ section is invisible to crawlers.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQPage schema to the homepage with the same FAQ content rendered in the client-side JavaScript.

findings.title: Tool Pages Missing WebApplication Schema
findings.description: Individual tool pages (lactose, gluten, histamine, fructose checkers, food diary, planner) have no specific schema. Only the homepage has WebApplication schema.
findings.recommendation: Add WebApplication or SoftwareApplication schema to each tool page with specific name, description, and applicationCategory.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Organization schema on homepage
WebApplication schema for main checker
Article schema with author and dates for blog/guide posts
MedicalWebPage schema for medical content pages
FAQPage schema on /faq page
ItemList schema on listing pages (tools, guides, blog)
HowTo schema on elimination diet guide
BreadcrumbList schema on all inner pages

findings.title: About Page Missing AboutPage Schema
findings.description: The About page contains rich author information but uses no specific schema. Adding AboutPage or Person schema would strengthen author E-E-A-T signals.
findings.recommendation: Add AboutPage schema with mainEntity Person for Dr. Emily Carter including credentials and description.

findings.title: Article Schema Publisher Logo Uses OG Image
findings.description: Article schema publisher logo URL points to og-default.png (a large OG image). Schema publisher logos should be small brand logos (recommended 600x60px or square).
findings.recommendation: Create a dedicated brand logo image (e.g., /images/brand-logo.png) and update the Article schema publisher logo URL.

findings.title: No Sitelinks Searchbox Schema
findings.description: The site has no search functionality and no SearchAction schema. While not critical, it's a missed opportunity for branded SERP features.
findings.recommendation: Consider adding a simple site search and SearchAction schema, or skip as low priority.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Astro SSG produces minimal JavaScript by default
Images use Astro Image component with WebP format
Hero image uses loading='eager' and fetchpriority='high'
Other images use loading='lazy'
No third-party analytics scripts
Minimal client-side JavaScript (only checker/diary scripts)

findings.title: Cannot Measure Live CWV (Site Not Deployed)
findings.description: Site is not deployed so no real Core Web Vitals data available. Estimated performance based on code analysis suggests good LCP/CLS but needs live validation.
findings.recommendation: Deploy the site first, then run Lighthouse/PageSpeed Insights to measure actual CWV metrics.

findings.title: 5 Font Weights Loaded
findings.description: Loading Outfit font in 5 weights (300, 400, 500, 600, 700) via @fontsource. Weight 300 doesn't appear to be used in the design.
findings.recommendation: Remove weight 300 import. Consider using Outfit variable font for a single file covering all weights.

findings.title: No Image Width/Height Attributes in CSS
findings.description: While Astro Image handles this via width/height props, some image containers use w-full without aspect-ratio constraints, potentially causing CLS if images load slowly.
findings.recommendation: Add aspect-ratio CSS to image containers to prevent layout shift.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt file present with comprehensive site map
Clear, structured content with question-based headings
Evidence-based citations from authoritative sources
Well-defined content policy section in llms.txt
Named author with credentials (Dr. Emily Carter)
Medical disclaimers improve AI citation accuracy

findings.title: Missing llms-full.txt
findings.description: llms.txt is present but llms-full.txt (expanded version with more detail per page) is missing. AI crawlers like ChatGPT Browse and Perplexity increasingly look for this.
findings.recommendation: Create llms-full.txt with expanded summaries of each page including key facts, statistics, and quotable passages.

findings.title: No Contact Information for AI Verification
findings.description: AI search engines use contact information as a trust signal. No email address is provided anywhere on the site.
findings.recommendation: Add a contact email to improve AI citation trust signals.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All images have descriptive alt text
Astro Image component auto-converts to WebP
Hero image optimized with eager loading and fetchpriority
Width and height attributes set for all images (800x450)
Images loaded lazily for below-fold content

findings.title: Duplicate Images in src/assets and public
findings.description: All images exist in both src/assets/images/ and public/images/. The public/images copies are redundant since Astro Image processes src/assets images. This doubles the repository size.
findings.recommendation: Remove duplicate images from public/images/ since Astro Image handles optimization from src/assets. Keep only static assets (favicon, OG image, JS files) in public/.

findings.title: No Favicon in PNG/ICO Format
findings.description: Only favicon.svg is provided. Some browsers and platforms (especially mobile) prefer PNG or ICO favicons for better rendering.
findings.recommendation: Add a 32x32 and 16x16 PNG favicon alongside the SVG.
